papers.title: A Systematic Survey on Optimal Construction Planning Methods (OCPM)
papers.abstract: This survey paper presents a comprehensive review of optimal construction planning methods, evaluating performance and dataset availability.

paperOverviews.problem: Unpredictable delays in large-scale construction planning.
paperOverviews.objective: Survey existing optimization techniques to mitigate delay risks.
paperOverviews.method: Systematic literature review (SLR) covering papers from 2010 to 2023.
paperOverviews.dataset: A curated dataset of 45 primary planning studies.
paperOverviews.findings: Hybrid mathematical models reduce planned variance by up to 15%.
paperOverviews.limitations: Does not address real-time rescheduling in response to unforeseen weather delays.

evidence.note: Evaluated on 45 primary planning studies in abstract.
